lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Distribution of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four to five longitudinal rows along the dorsal-lateral surface, primarily visible between the first and second dorsal fins.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with circular clusters to form a partial grid-like structure along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Pronounced horizontal linear features running parallel to the longitudinal axis on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient (light upper margin, dark lower margin).

other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-intensity white pixel cluster located at the distal tip of the ventral caudal lobe.
